title: ScamWorld: An Interactive Environment for Evaluating Web Agents Against Online Fraud
why: Interactive scam-site testbed measures web-agent fraud susceptibility during browse/shop/account tasks.
mechanism: Reconstructs 363 documented scam websites (+53 legit controls) as persistent local sites so web agents can be evaluated safely/repeatably on fraud mechanisms before final payment/credential/wallet actions; trajectory logging for deception analysis.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: six frontier-LLM web agents; baseline deception 11–35%; agents proceed more readily on payments than credentials/wallet; some acknowledge suspicion yet continue; one-sentence warning lowers deception but also legitimate completion.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract + comment (15 pages; Code github.com/wuyoscar/scamworld-bench)

title: JHiMA-WebRL: A Joint Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Long-Horizon Web Tasks
why: Jointly trains web-GUI planner+actor with hierarchical GRPO on WebArena long-horizon tasks.
mechanism: Hierarchical multi-agent RL: teacher-annotated subtask supervision from multimodal GUI trajectories fine-tunes decomposer+subtask-conditioned actor; extended GRPO jointly optimizes both via hierarchical rollout grouping on interactive WebArena.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: JHiMA-WebRL-14B (7B+7B) WebArena-Lite-v2 avg success 37.2% vs 24% ScaleCUA-32B RL fine-tuned on same tasks/protocol; jointly updating decomposer beats actor-only RL.

title: Computer-Use Agents Gain Little Benefit from a World Model When Conditioned on Tutorials
why: Ablates CUA world-model rollouts vs tutorials+judge on OSWorld/ScienceBoard; finds little WM gain.
mechanism: Builds OSWorld-Tutorial and ScienceBoard-Tutorial; RAG-PolicyJudge proposes actions conditioned on tutorials then MLLM judge selects; isolates world-model look-ahead (text next-state or oracle visual futures) given tutorials.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: with tutorials present, RAG-PJ gains little from world-model rollouts even with perfect visual futures; bottleneck is judge reasoning over futures/task completion rather than rollout fidelity.

title: Interpretable Early Termination of Web Navigation Agents via Closed Sequential Pattern Mining
why: Mines MiniWoB++ failure-signature patterns for early stop of web-nav agents to cut tokens.
mechanism: Applies BIDE+ closed sequential pattern mining on K-step prefixes of web-nav agent traces to build human-reviewable failure-signature library/taxonomy with repair recommendations; early-termination policy from signatures.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported: 1544 MiniWoB++ traces from 3 open-weight LMs; best F1 0.717 at K=3 (Exclude-errors); recovers 88% test failures within 3 steps; saves 26.3% tokens at 92% precision.
evidence_locator: arXiv abs abstract + comment (AID-Wild workshop CAIS 2026)

mechanism: Mobile-native harness: frozen base + permanence-aware required layer for location/proactive/scarce channels; uniform plugin contract for composable/checkable/replaceable extensions; tiered commissioned-authoring via web coding agent with on-device validation/admission.
